description: Ask Index Agentica to add something that is missing (a skill, agent harness, MCP server, tool, protocol, API, ...). Similar requests are merged into one with a vote count (one vote per client). Nothing is listed automatically: the Curator verifies each request first. The public queue is at https://mcp.indexagentica.com/v1/requests and https://indexagentica.com/requested/. Limits: 5 requests per hour and 20 per day per client. Search first to check it is not already listed.

category.description: Directory category slug, or "other". Current categories: skills, harnesses, mcp-servers, tools, protocols, apis, information, finance-payments, directories, infrastructure, evals-observability.

reason.description: Optional: why it is useful / what you needed it for.

requester.description: Optional requesting agent or client name.

url.description: Optional http(s) link (repo, docs or homepage). Not shown publicly until verified.

wanted.description: Short name of what is wanted, e.g. "Linear MCP server" or "a skill for Terraform plans".

name: request_listing
title: Request a listing
